one_time_products.title: Remove Ads
one_time_products.description: Permanently removes banner and interstitial ads. Rewarded videos stay optional, so you can still watch one for a free hint or coins.

one_time_products.title: 100 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 100 coins. Spend coins on hints (25 each) and on unlocking the Midnight board theme.

one_time_products.title: 400 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 400 coins. Spend coins on hints (25 each) and on unlocking the Midnight board theme.

one_time_products.title: 800 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 800 coins. Great value: spend coins on hints (25 each) and on unlocking the Midnight board theme.

one_time_products.title: 2000 Coins
one_time_products.description: Adds 2000 coins, our best value. Spend coins on hints (25 each) and on unlocking the Midnight board theme.

one_time_products.title: 5 Lives
one_time_products.description: Refills your hearts to 5 right away. Hearts start Endless warehouses (one per board); the 500-level campaign and the daily board never use them.

one_time_products.title: 1hr Unlimited
one_time_products.description: One hour of unlimited hearts: start as many Endless warehouses as you like. The campaign and the daily board never use hearts.

one_time_products.title: Unlimited Lives
one_time_products.description: Unlimited hearts forever: Endless warehouses never cost a heart again. The campaign and the daily board are always free.

one_time_products.title: Hint Pack
one_time_products.description: Adds 10 hints. Each hint draws the route to your next push from the level's solution; a hint is never spent when a crate is already stuck.

one_time_products.title: Starter Pack
one_time_products.description: One-time bundle for new players: 100 coins + 5 hints + 5 hearts + Ads Off (banners and interstitials removed for good).

subscriptions.title: Season Pass
subscriptions.description: Monthly pass: ad-free play, +100 coins every day, all board themes unlocked, and unlimited hints. Cancel anytime in Google Play.

subscriptions.title: Weekly Pass
subscriptions.description: Weekly pass: ad-free play, +50 coins every day, all board themes unlocked, and unlimited hints. Cancel anytime in Google Play.
